decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on using cheap disruptive spells and efficient creatures to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. It combines aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler with powerful tempo plays like Counterspell and Unholy Heat to control the board and ensure a quick victory. The deck also includes card selection and filtering tools like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to maintain consistency and find key cards. With a mix of creatures, burn spells, and counter magic, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on using creatures with persist and undying abilities to generate value and trigger effects like Blood Artist or Hapatra. The deck also utilizes cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to search for specific creatures in the deck, creating a toolbox approach to combo off with Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. The deck aims to control the board while setting up its combo pieces, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with value and incremental advantages. The mana base includes various lands to support the deck's color requirements and provide utility.

This deck focuses on using a variety of control spells and powerful planeswalkers to disrupt opponent's strategies and control the board. It also utilizes a mix of removal spells and versatile creatures to maintain board presence and pressure opponents. The deck aims to control the game by denying opponent's resources and slowing down their game plan, ultimately leading to victory through overwhelming board presence and card advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing cycling creatures and spells to quickly fill up the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring back all of the powerful creatures from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent. The key is to cycle through the deck efficiently, controlling the board with disruptive creatures like Grief and utilizing counter spells to protect the combo. The land base is designed to support the different colors needed for the deck while also providing access to utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures for protection against counter spells.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. This combo relies on hitting Leyline Binding to guarantee hitting the desired creatures. Teferi, Time Raveler is included to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also runs a small control package with cards like Lightning Bolt, Spell Pierce, and Prismatic Ending. The mana base is built to support all the colors necessary for the combo pieces.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to create powerful combos with cards like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. It also utilizes cards like Leyline Binding and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and protect its combo pieces. The deck includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending, as well as card advantage engines like Wrenn and Six and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize the chances of hitting its combo pieces.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing powerful Elemental creatures and spells to dominate the battlefield. By using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending to control the opponent's board, along with Elementals like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef to generate value and card advantage, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent. The inclusion of various utility lands and cards like Wrenn and Six provide additional flexibility and consistency in order to secure victory through efficient control and powerful Elemental synergies.

This deck focuses on applying early pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker while disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect key creatures and generate card advantage. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger can further disrupt the opponent's mana base and game plan, allowing the Rakdos Aggro archetype to quickly close out games.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using burn spells and removal while ramping into big threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also utilizes cards like Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The inclusion of Obosh, the Preypiercer as a companion allows for extra damage output. The deck focuses on setting up a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy, ultimately winning through a combination of damage and control.

The deck aims to utilize Underworld Breach, along with cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, to create a powerful combo engine that allows for efficient card selection, mana generation, and repeatable spell casting. By filling the graveyard with various cards and using Breach to cast them from the graveyard, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with a flurry of spells and creatures. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce helps to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

This deck focuses on using cascade spells to rapidly deploy threats onto the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By cascading into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls or Violent Outburst, the deck can quickly flood the board with creatures and apply pressure to the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect its game plan and counter opposing threats. With a mix of tempo plays and explosive creature drops, this deck aims to close out games quickly and decisively.

This deck focuses on using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Leyline Binding to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Archon of Cruelty to create powerful combos. The deck also includes a mix of counterspells like Mana Leak and Spell Pierce to protect its key pieces, along with planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six for additional control and card advantage. The mana base is built to support these strategies and allow for flexibility in casting your spells.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming your opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Seasoned Pyromancer, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Grief, you can apply early pressure and disrupt their game plan. Alongside removal spells like Terminate, Lightning Bolt, and Fatal Push, you can control the board while continuing to push for damage. The deck also includes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to give your creatures extra value and resilience. With a mix of hand disruption and efficient threats, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to close out games swiftly.

The deck focuses on using The Underworld Cookbook to enable graveyard shenanigans and cheat out big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn with cards like Goryo's Vengeance. It also utilizes cards like Profane Tutor and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Ovalchase Daredevil provide additional value and versatility. The mana base is designed to support the deck's game plan efficiently. The deck aims to be aggressive, disruptive, and efficient in its execution.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with creatures like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. It utilizes spells like Lightning Bolt, Spell Pierce, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat to control the board and protect its creatures. Mishra's Bauble, Consider, Expressive Iteration, and Thought Scour help with card draw and selection. The mana base consists of blue and red lands to support the spells and creatures in the deck. Ledger Shredder is included for graveyard hate. The deck aims to quickly put pressure on the opponent and maintain control of the game.

The deck focuses on disruption and control through counterspells and removal spells, supported by powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Jace. It also utilizes cards that help stabilize the board like Supreme Verdict and Leyline Binding. The deck also has utility lands to provide additional card advantage and versatility. The inclusion of Chalice of the Void can help shut down opponents' key cards, while the companion Kaheera provides additional synergy and support for the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue opponents in the long run.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures with various abilities to put pressure on the opponent. By utilizing a wide range of colors, it can adapt to different situations and opponents. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional utility and flexibility to the deck. Key cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tribal Flames help to maintain board presence and deal damage efficiently. With a mix of creatures, spells, and lands, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to bring out powerful land-based threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. By utilizing cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Amulet of Vigor, the deck can exploit land triggers and untap lands multiple times in a turn. With the use of Urza's Saga and Expedition Map, the deck can search for key land pieces to assemble combos and overwhelm opponents. The inclusion of Summoner's Pact also allows for flexible creature tutoring to adapt to various situations. Ultimately, the deck aims to create explosive plays and outvalue opponents with its land synergy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful cascade spells. The deck aims to utilize cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into high-impact spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury, generating a massive board presence and putting pressure on the opponent. With a mix of disruptive spells like Mystical Dispute and tempo plays like Brazen Borrower, the deck aims to maintain control while leveraging its aggressive strategy to close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures to create a toolbox of options for different situations. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, players can search for specific creatures to deal with threats or advance their game plan. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician is a key piece of the combo, allowing players to remove counters from their creatures and draw cards. The deck also includes cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons to generate additional value from creature interactions. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents by leveraging its versatile creature toolbox.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to disrupt your opponent's board by sacrificing tokens from Dwarven Mine or other cheap creatures to potentially put a powerful creature like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. The deck also uses Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to create a copy of a key card or to generate tokens to sacrifice for Indomitable Creativity. The deck includes counterspells like Spell Pierce and removal like Lightning Bolt to control the game until the combo can be assembled. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty by sacrificing tokens created by Dwarven Mine, as well as Leyline Binding to help protect the combo. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide additional synergy and control elements to disrupt opponents. The deck also includes a suite of efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Change the Equation offer additional ways to generate value and find key combo pieces.

This Elemental control deck focuses on manipulating the board state through various spells and abilities while using powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to establish dominance. The deck utilizes cards such as Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the pace of the game, while also having access to powerful removal in the form of Prismatic Ending and Unholy Heat. The deck also includes additional Elemental synergy with cards like Risen Reef and Titania, Protector of Argoth to generate value and overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on maximizing the counters placed on creatures with the help of Hardened Scales, The Ozolith, and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp. It aims to create a board presence quickly with cards like Hangarback Walker and Walking Ballista, while also having the ability to protect its threats with Welding Jar. The deck can deal massive amounts of damage and overwhelm opponents with its aggressive gameplay, making it a strong contender in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Death's Shadow and Tarmogoyf to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By combining hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, the deck can control the opponent's board while maintaining pressure. The deck also includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to generate card advantage and keep up tempo. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on cycling creatures with discard abilities to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By filling the graveyard with creatures, the deck can cast Living End to return all creatures to the battlefield from the graveyard, often overwhelming the opponent with a large army. The deck also includes counterspells and cascade spells to support the combo and protect against disruption. The key strategy is to set up the graveyard, disrupt the opponent, and then unleash a massive creature revival with Living End to secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Grief and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to pressure the opponent. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck aims to close out the game quickly by combining creature aggression with removal and disruption spells, while also including powerful cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to provide additional value and late-game threats if needed. Additionally, playing Blood Moon can disrupt the opponent's mana base and give this deck a crucial advantage.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By using cards like Seasoned Pyromancer, Dauthi Voidwalker, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to quickly pressure the opponent's life total. Additionally, cards like Grief, Thoughtseize, and Terminate help disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice provide extra value and potential for additional damage. Overall, this deck focuses on fast-paced aggression and disruption to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of mill cards and control spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy while rapidly depleting their library. By consistently milling cards with Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity, the deck aims to trigger Archive Trap for massive mill potential. The inclusion of disruption spells like Surgical Extraction and Drown in the Loch provide additional control, while Tasha's Hideous Laughter serves as a powerful finisher. The mana base includes various lands to support the deck's strategy and maintain consistency in milling the opponent.

This deck focuses on a fast-paced strategy that utilizes aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes disruptive elements like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to control the opponent's spells. The deck has a good balance of tempo plays with cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain card advantage. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes lands that produce both red and blue mana. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively with cheap and efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and cheap removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Mishra's Bauble, Consider, and Expressive Iteration to smooth out draws and find key pieces. The mana base is optimized to support casting spells efficiently, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands. Overall, the strategy revolves around applying pressure early and disrupting the opponent's strategy to close out the game quickly.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy threats like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell. Mishra's Bauble and other cards like Consider and Expressive Iteration help to dig for more threats and keep the pressure on the opponent. Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide additional removal options to clear the way for your creatures to attack. This deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain tempo to secure a swift victory.
